highlightAliases.old: Women affected 2–3× more than men overall, but this gender parity disappears in old age (p1608) — LORA occurs with roughly equal M:F (p1610)
highlightAliases.new: Women affected 2–3× more than men overall, but the female predominance narrows in late-onset disease (p1608) — LORA occurs with roughly equal M:F (p1610)

highlightAliases.old: Vectra DA: FDA-approved 12-protein multibiomarker blood test for RA disease activity, complements (does not replace) clinical judgment (p1612)
highlightAliases.new: Vectra DA: laboratory-developed 12-protein blood test for RA disease activity, complements (does not replace) clinical judgment (p1612; Labcorp Vectra sample report, test 504965, documents its regulatory status)

highlightAliases.old: Glucocorticoid dose-response in Medicare beneficiaries >75 yr: ≤5 mg, >5–10 mg, >10 mg/day → 20%, 32%, 47% increased serious-infection risk vs 13% in non-users (p1618)Current practice (not the book): in the source (Medicare RA patients ≥75 y on stable DMARDs) 12.8/20.0/32.0/46.8 are crude hospitalized-infection rates per 100 person-years, not % increased risk; adjusted HRs vs no glucocorticoid 1.31, 1.74, 2.23 — George et al., Ann Intern Med 2020, Table 3.
highlightAliases.new: Glucocorticoid dose-response in Medicare patients aged 75 or older: ≤5 mg, >5–10 mg, >10 mg/day → approximately 20, 32 and 47 hospitalized infections per 100 person-years, respectively, versus 13 per 100 person-years without glucocorticoids (p1618)Current practice (not the book): in the source (Medicare RA patients ≥75 y on stable DMARDs) 12.8/20.0/32.0/46.8 are crude hospitalized-infection rates per 100 person-years, not % increased risk; adjusted HRs vs no glucocorticoid 1.31, 1.74, 2.23 — George et al., Ann Intern Med 2020, Table 3.

highlightAliases.old: Belimumab (anti-BAFF) — first lupus drug in its class to get FDA approval, 2011, indication expanded to lupus nephritis 2021; voclosporin (oral calcineurin inhibitor) also approved for active lupus nephritis, role in older patients untested (p1621–1622)
highlightAliases.new: Belimumab (anti-BAFF) — first lupus drug in its class to get FDA approval, 2011, indication expanded to adult active lupus nephritis in December 2020; voclosporin (oral calcineurin inhibitor) also approved for active lupus nephritis, role in older patients untested (p1621–1622; FDA supplemental approval letter, December 2020)

highlightAliases.old: mRNA vaccines preferred over J&J; immunosuppressed patients get an extra dose ≥28 days after primary series (p1627–1628)
highlightAliases.new: Historical vaccine schedule in this edition: mRNA vaccines were preferred to J&J, and an extra dose at least 28 days after completing the two-dose mRNA primary series was advised for immunosuppressed patients (p1627)

highlightAliases.old: Typical RA affects women 2–3× more than men, but this gender parity disappears in old age (p1608) — LORA occurs with roughly equal frequency in men and women (p1610).
highlightAliases.new: Typical RA affects women 2–3× more than men, but the female predominance narrows in late-onset disease (p1608) — LORA occurs with roughly equal frequency in men and women (p1610).

highlightAliases.old: ≤5 mg, >5–10 mg, and >10 mg/day of glucocorticoid conferred 20%, 32%, and 47% increased risk of serious infection respectively, versus 13% in non-users (p1618).
highlightAliases.new: ≤5 mg, >5–10 mg, and >10 mg/day of glucocorticoid were associated with approximately 20, 32 and 47 hospitalized infections per 100 person-years, respectively, versus 13 per 100 person-years without glucocorticoids (p1618; George et al., Table 3).

highlightAliases.old: FDA-approved in 2011 as the first lupus drug in its class (anti-BAFF); indication expanded to active lupus nephritis in 2021 (p1621–1622).
highlightAliases.new: FDA-approved in 2011 as the first lupus drug in its class (anti-BAFF); indication expanded to adult active lupus nephritis in December 2020 (p1621–1622; FDA supplemental approval letter, December 2020).

highlightAliases.old: Hypertrophic osteoarthropathy = most common malignancy-associated rheumatic syndrome, almost always from metastatic lung cancer (p1625)
highlightAliases.new: Hypertrophic osteoarthropathy = most common malignancy-associated rheumatic syndrome, almost always from metastatic lung cancer in the Western world (p1625)

highlightAliases.old: Historical vaccine schedule in this edition: mRNA vaccines were preferred to J&J, and an extra dose at least 28 days after the primary series was advised for immunosuppressed patients (p1627–1628)
highlightAliases.new: Historical vaccine schedule in this edition: mRNA vaccines were preferred to J&J, and an extra dose at least 28 days after completing the two-dose mRNA primary series was advised for immunosuppressed patients (p1627)
